name: Smarties Candy Rolls (Powdered Dextrose Wafers)
whyItWorks: Made almost entirely of pure dextrose (glucose). Unlike complex sugars or lactose, pure dextrose requires zero enzymatic breakdown and is absorbed directly through the intestinal wall, providing instant cellular energy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dissolve on tongue. Frequently used by diabetic and IBD patients for rapid, clean blood sugar support.
watchOuts: Very high glycemic index; rapid absorption.
